_comment: Schema v2 adds data_policy labels per route, enabling the safety ceiling enforced by lib/policy.py. Routes WITHOUT a top-level data_policies key are schema v1 and pass through unfiltered.

private-safe.description: Zero-retention or own-key billing. Safe for private and confidential source code.
private-safe.basis: Provider docs or own-credential direct route.

training-optin.description: Provider states data may be used to improve the model during a free period. NOT for private code.

trial-logged.description: Trial/limited-time endpoint with session logging. Docs instruct not to submit personal or confidential data. NOT for private code.

training-explicit.description: Provider explicitly trains on prompts/completions. Never use for private or public real code.
